title: ConventionsFinding
description: One check outcome inside a repo result (D144). `checkId` names the validator check; `ruleId` is the catalog rule it enforces, `null` for a check with no rule yet. `status` is pass, warn, fail, unverified (the check could not decide) or skipped (not applicable). `file`/`line` locate the evidence and are `null` when the finding is about the repo as a whole.
